# T002 — Python S0 fixtures (16)

Seed: `P024-REPOMAPVERIFY-S0-2026-11-14`. Each fixture is a synthetic repo
(`repo/` — fixed file tree + fixed content, with `.repomapverify.toml`
declaring entrypoints), a synthetic claimed map (`claimed-map.json`,
completeness `FULL_GRAPH`, snapshot hash bound to the fixture repo), and a
HAND-WRITTEN Golden Expected Graph (`golden.json` — expected nodes, edges
with line/statement evidence, external imports, unknown imports,
dynamic-unknown, entrypoints, reachable/isolated sets; written by reasoning
about the fixture source, never generated by running the extractor).

Run: `node scripts/t002-poc-audit.mjs` (or
`npx vitest run tests/fixtures/s0/python/`). Evidence:
`03_evidence/T002/POC_RUN.json` + `POC_RUN.log`.

## Controls (8) — claimed map == ground truth → PASS, 0 findings

| Fixture | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `py-c01-basic-imports` | `import a.b`, `from a.b import attr` (attribute, no sub-edge) |
| `py-c02-relative-imports` | `from . import x`, `from ..pkg import y`, relative levels |
| `py-c03-init-reexport` | `__init__.py` re-export (`from .core import run`); `from pkg import run` is an attribute, not a module |
| `py-c04-src-layout` | `src/` search path (`src/app/api.py` is `app.api`) |
| `py-c05-from-submodule-vs-attr` | `from billing import api` (sub-module edge) vs `from billing.api import get_invoice` (attribute, no sub-edge); `from billing.reports import monthly` (package sub-module) |
| `py-c06-conditional-imports` | `try/except ImportError` (conditional) + `if TYPE_CHECKING:` (conditional + typeOnly); stdlib `typing` + third-party `fastapi` external |
| `py-c07-external-and-stdlib` | stdlib (`json`, `os.path`, `sys`) + third-party (`numpy`) counted external, no repo edges |
| `py-c08-multi-entrypoint` | two declared entrypoints (`cli.py`, `worker.py`); reachable union |

## Planted (8) — exactly one planted defect class each → FAIL, detected

| Fixture | Planted class | Expected findings |
|---|---|---|
| `py-p01-hallucinated-edge` | hallucinated edge | `HALLUCINATED_EDGE api→billing/refunds.py`, `HALLUCINATED_MODULE billing/refunds.py` |
| `py-p02-wrong-entrypoint` | wrong entrypoint (toml declares `cli.py`, map claims `billing/api.py`) | `WRONG_ENTRYPOINT billing/api.py` |
| `py-p03-missing-edge` | missing edge | `MISSING_EDGE api→billing/auth.py` |
| `py-p04-unclaimed-reachable` | unclaimed reachable module | `UNCLAIMED_REACHABLE_MODULE billing/migrations.py`, `MISSING_EDGE api→billing/migrations.py` |
| `py-p05-name-collision` | name collision (`shop/utils.py` vs `lib/utils.py`) | `NAME_COLLISION_CONFUSION`, `HALLUCINATED_EDGE`, `MISSING_EDGE` (all `cart→…utils.py`) |
| `py-p06-dynamic-import-misread` | dynamic import misread (`importlib.import_module(name)` claimed as a definite edge) | `DYNAMIC_IMPORT_UNKNOWN loader.py`, `HALLUCINATED_EDGE loader→plugins/alpha.py` |
| `py-p07-reexport-misread` | re-export misread (barrel transparency: `main→pkg/core.py` claimed instead of `main→pkg/__init__.py`) | `HALLUCINATED_EDGE main→pkg/core.py`, `MISSING_EDGE main→pkg/__init__.py` |
| `py-p08-alias-misparse` | alias misparse (`import pkg.utils as utils` claimed as root `utils.py`) | `HALLUCINATED_EDGE main→utils.py`, `HALLUCINATED_MODULE utils.py`, `MISSING_EDGE main→pkg/utils.py` |

## Tests

- `poc-audit.test.ts` — 16 fixtures (golden parity field-by-field +
  PoC audit vs claimed map) + 5 adapter tests.
- `extractor-units.test.ts` — 15 unit tests for rules the fixtures do
  not cover (parse error, generated-code exclusion, relative escape,
  wildcard, `__import__`/importlib literals vs variables, exec/eval,
  unresolvable repo-local, duplicate collapse, src/root shadowing,
  namespace packages, nested imports, no-toml, 1 MiB cap, attribute
  from-imports, `__init__` self-edge skip).
